environment.server: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

limitations: CPU profiles are main-thread only; allocator tracking includes background threads
syscall traces include process setup/warmup/cleanup; protocol cycles are not general network round trips
pipelining is throughput-oriented and must not be conflated with scalar query latency
The diagnostic pool reverse order has Rust/C 1.549; retain it rather than replacing the separate frozen three-run acceptance results.
Allocation observer classification misses the Linux eight-frame allocation-helper prefix; original categories are not an ordinary-allocation estimate and require a separate corrected analysis.
Native/client layer differences are separate matched paths, not additive recoverable costs.
GIL transitions and scheduler wakeups remain unmeasured; syscall and protocol counts are not substitutes.
No process exceeds 5 percent in the before snapshot; after snapshot docker-proxy is 11.8 percent. Snapshots are not continuous idle telemetry.

external_artifacts.note: Original Memray captures, pstats files, probe binaries, wheel, and PostgreSQL log remain in the CI artifact; result-file hashes are retained in the archived manifest.
